description: Summary figure: family placement, clade expression, paralog differences versus active site, and synteny
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.cluster.hierarchy import linkage, dendrogram, fcluster
from scipy.spatial.distance import squareform
ap=pd.read_csv("artifacts/gdsl_allpairs.csv")
labs=[l[1:].strip() for l in open("artifacts/gdsl_family.fasta") if l.startswith(">")]
n=len(labs); P=np.zeros((n,n))
for _,r in ap.iterrows(): P[int(r.i),int(r.j)]=P[int(r.j),int(r.i)]=r.pid
locus=[l.split("|")[1] for l in labs]; sym=[l.split("|")[2] for l in labs]
q=locus.index("AT5G03810")
D=100-P; np.fill_diagonal(D,0); D=(D+D.T)/2
Z=linkage(squareform(D,checks=False),method="average")
cl=fcluster(Z,t=45,criterion="distance")   # <=45% divergence i.e. >=55% identity
clade=[i for i in range(n) if cl[i]==cl[q]]
print("clade of AT5G03810 at >=55%% identity cutoff: ", [locus[i] for i in clade])
E=pd.read_csv("artifacts/expression_E-MTAB-7978.csv",index_col=0)
diff=pd.read_csv("artifacts/paralog_differences_mapped.csv")

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,9))
# A: identity profile
ax=fig.add_subplot(2,2,1)
o=np.argsort(-P[q])[1:]
v=P[q][o]
ax.plot(range(1,len(v)+1),v,"o-",ms=3,color="#4a5568",lw=0.8)
for k in range(4):
    ax.annotate(locus[o[k]],(k+1,v[k]),textcoords="offset points",xytext=(8,2),fontsize=8,color="#d1495b")
ax.axhline(50,ls=":",c="k",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("rank among 108 other Arabidopsis GDSL proteins")
ax.set_ylabel("global %identity to AT5G03810")
ax.set_title("A  AT5G03810 has four close relatives, then a sharp drop")
ax.set_xlim(0,40)
# B: expression
ax=fig.add_subplot(2,2,2)
cols=["AT5G03810","AT5G03820","AT5G22810","AT3G53100","AT3G16370"]
sub=E[cols].fillna(0)
keep=sub[(sub>1).any(axis=1)]
im=ax.imshow(np.log10(keep.values.T+1),aspect="auto",cmap="magma")
ax.set_yticks(range(len(cols))); ax.set_yticklabels(cols,fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(keep))); ax.set_xticklabels([t.replace(", not applicable","")[:28] for t in keep.index],rotation=90,fontsize=6)
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax,label="log10(TPM+1)",fraction=0.03)
ax.set_title("B  Clade expression, E-MTAB-7978 (54 tissues)",fontsize=10)
# C: paralog differences vs active site
ax=fig.add_subplot(2,2,3)
ax.hist(diff.dmin.dropna(),bins=np.arange(0,45,2.5),color="#d1495b")
ax.axvline(10,ls="--",c="k"); ax.text(10.5,4.2,"active-site pocket\n(<=10 A of Ser37)",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("distance of differing residue to catalytic Ser37 OG (A)")
ax.set_ylabel("number of paralog differences")
ax.set_title("C  34 substitutions; 1 inside the pocket (V51I), 0 catalytic")
# D: synteny
ax=fig.add_subplot(2,2,4); ax.axis("off")
tracks=[("A. thaliana chr5",[("AT5G03800",1013939-3000,1013939-800,"#cbd5e0"),("AT5G03810",1013939,1015345,"#d1495b"),("AT5G03820",1015586,1017514,"#f4a261")]),
        ]
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0.05,0.72),0.9,0.001,color="k"))
def gene(ax,x0,x1,y,c,lbl):
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((x0,y),x1-x0,0.06,color=c)); ax.text((x0+x1)/2,y+0.075,lbl,ha="center",fontsize=8)
gene(ax,0.08,0.33,0.70,"#cbd5e0","AT5G03800")
gene(ax,0.36,0.58,0.70,"#d1495b","AT5G03810"); gene(ax,0.60,0.86,0.70,"#f4a261","AT5G03820")
ax.text(0.47,0.64,"241 bp",ha="center",fontsize=7)
ax.text(0.02,0.86,"A. thaliana  chr5:1,013,939-1,017,514 (- strand)",fontsize=9,weight="bold")
gene(ax,0.08,0.33,0.36,"#cbd5e0","AT5G03800 orth"); gene(ax,0.36,0.62,0.36,"#9aa4b1","single GDSL gene")
gene(ax,0.68,0.92,0.36,"#cbd5e0","AT5G03830 orth")
ax.text(0.02,0.52,"A. lyrata scaffold 6:1,199,343-1,210,119  (one gene, no tandem partner)",fontsize=9,weight="bold")
ax.text(0.02,0.22,"Eutrema salsugineum, B. oleracea, Camelina: one GDSL gene per syntenic block\n(each is ortholog of BOTH AT5G03810 and AT5G03820)",fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_title("D  The tandem pair is an A. thaliana-specific duplication")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
